CustomField.formula: CASE( TimeZone__c , "Asia/Kolkata", TEXT( TIMEVALUE(Start_Date_Time__c) + 19800000), "Asia/Dubai", TEXT( TIMEVALUE(Start_Date_Time__c) + 25200000), "Asia/Singapore", TEXT( TIMEVALUE(Start_Date_Time__c) + 10800000), "Australia/Sydney", IF( OR( MONTH(DATEVALUE(Start_Date_Time__c)) >= 10, MONTH(DATEVALUE(Start_Date_Time__c)) <= 3 ), TEXT( TIMEVALUE(Start_Date_Time__c) + 39600000 +7200000), TEXT( TIMEVALUE(Start_Date_Time__c) + 36000000 +7200000) ), NULL )
